gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-glegoo: Wide-spaced, regal, a little strange. Metamorphous lets its heavy and light strokes shift softly, while Glegoo, a classic serif, keeps big open curves and a tall lowercase that feel scholarly beside it.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hanuman: Metamorphous has a high-set midline that gives it a distinctive stance. Hanuman, a classic serif, follows with a high-waisted lowercase and wide-set terminals on s, so a long page feels traditional and refined.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noticia-text: Spacious, regal capitals with a mild, friendly stroke contrast set the tone in Metamorphous. And Noticia Text, a text serif, lets its curved letters open wide with lowercase bodies filling most of the height, which gives the whole page a literary, dignified feel.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-piazzolla: Metamorphous brings large sidebearings and soft contrast in every curve, a commanding and distinctive voice. Piazzolla, a classic serif, answers with lowercase nearly matching its capitals and a lowercase e opened wide, refined and authoritative.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-pridi: Metamorphous is the showpiece, commanding and distinctive, with a comfortable level of stroke contrast and generous sidebearings. Pridi, a classic serif, does the quieter job, with small letters standing proud and curve ends sitting well clear of the stem.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-scope-one: Commanding in its wide spacing and high midline, Metamorphous brings stems a touch heavier than its crossbars to the heading. Scope One's big x-height and open counters are the draw.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-slabo-13px: Metamorphous has large sidebearings all around, which gives the heading a spacious, commanding look. Slabo 13px is bookish and dignified, so a sensible plan is to give it comfortable size, since its tall a, e and s open up nicely.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-suwannaphum: Suwannaphum reads dignified and editorial, with a high x-height like a squared-off woodblock letter and a very open c. Metamorphous above it adds gentle weight shifts in its bowls, and I'd give the serif body a little extra size.
gen-gf-offside-gf-epunda-slab: Offside spreads its letters wide, with curves that refuse to close and a level beat that never accents weight. Epunda Slab, a serif, gives it a dignified partner with tall rounded forms.
gen-gf-offside-gf-fauna-one: Offside keeps every curve open and its tracking wide. Fauna One, a text serif, adds a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and descenders, and a generous entry into the e, so the page feels literary and dignified against the heading's flat, level hum.
